name: Kurusu Akane
source:
A colleague of Konno who works for the same transportation company.
He is often thought to be a shallow guy because of his flirtatious behavior, but he is not crazy.
As a spoiled person who is also good at spoiling other people, he has a lot of female friends.
He is actually a hardworking and serious guy... but to what extent.
